dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Cardinals Get Shut Down, Blue Jays Take Game 1-5"

The Toronto Blue Jays took game one of the doubleheader with a convincing 5-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals. George Springer led the Blue Jays with a 2-hit performance, scoring 2 runs and driving in 2 RBI. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and Alejandro Kirk also played key roles in the win. On the mound, Kevin Gausman pitched 5.2 strong innings, allowing just 1 earned run and striking out 4. Blaze Jordan had a standout game for the Cardinals, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Blue Jays' strong offense.

"Rangers Fall to Astros in Extra Innings"

The Houston Astros took a thrilling 5-4 win over the Texas Rangers in extra innings. Elias Díaz had a big game for the Astros, hitting a 5th inning homer to put his team up 3-2. Christian Walker also contributed 2 RBIs for the Rangers, but it wasn't enough. Steven Okert earned the win for the Astros, while Josh Hader closed out the game with a save.

"Giants Fall Short to Padres in San Diego"

The San Diego Padres took a 6-5 win over the San Francisco Giants in a back-and-forth game. Osleivis Basabe had a monster game for the Padres, hitting a 2-run homer to put his team up 4-3. Jake Cronenworth also contributed 2 RBIs for the Padres, while Mason Miller earned the win in relief. The Padres took the lead in the bottom of the 9th on a walk-off single by Freddy Fermin.
